unlisted_practices: Make AI-generated insights accessible to patients with Parkinson disease
Have a health care professional communicate sensitive AI predictions (e.g., risk prediction) while recognizing individual differences in desire and response
Use different implementation precautions for risk, progression, and medication response prediction

screen.reason: Qualitative study exploring patient perspectives on ethical aspects and safeguards for AI in Parkinson disease management, but does not test an organizational deployment practice.
